name: Do tankless water heaters require special maintenance after replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do tankless water heaters require special maintenance after replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, tankless water heaters benefit from annual maintenance, primarily flushing the unit to remove mineral buildup. This process helps maintain efficiency and extend the unit's lifespan. Some models have internal diagnostic systems that can alert you to potential issues. Regular professional maintenance can prevent costly repairs and ensure optimal performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, annual flushing to remove mineral buildup is recommended to maintain efficiency and extend the unit's lifespan.
